text: Government has appropriated PHP 50M for an OFW victim-restitution fund (FY2026). Draft the disbursement-criteria framework: (1) eligibility under RA 8042 + RA 11862 amendments, (2) priority tiers (acute / chronic / historical), (3) the OFW Welfare Administration intake procedure, (4) recovery-from-agency parallel-track to avoid double-pay, (5) the audit + reporting framework. Output as a structured policy-brief.
